asked.item: Carousel made via n8n not visible in the app

verdict.reason: The FAQ says all generated visuals, including carousels made in n8n, are saved at Videos, and it says how to find and open them.

steps.text: Visuals you generate, including carousels made in n8n, are saved at Videos.
If you can't find it, go directly to my.blotato.com/videos and look for your recent creations there.
To download or publish it, click on it in the Videos library to open the editor.
